## Validation

- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib bin test`
- [ ] `flutter analyze`
- [ ] `flutter test`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/static-validate.py`
- [ ] Linux build completed
- [ ] Visual changes include an updated preview or screenshot
- [ ] Documentation and audits were updated
